---
title: "GBIF — exploratory assessment of data availability"
output: pdf_document
params:
  context_file: NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{float}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \floatplacement{figure}{H}
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "")
ctx <- readRDS(params$context_file)
tbl <- function(df, ...) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(cat("_No data._\n\n"))
  print(knitr::kable(df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", digits = 2,
                     longtable = nrow(df) > 25, row.names = FALSE, ...))
}
# LaTeX runs inside a scratch directory where render_report() copied the figures to
# figures/; only short relative names reach LaTeX (no drive letters, user names or spaces).
rel_path <- function(path) paste0("figures/", basename(path))
fig <- function(path, cap = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(path) && !is.na(path) && file.exists(path)) {
    cat("\n\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=\\textwidth,height=0.45\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{",
        rel_path(path), "}\n", if (!is.null(cap)) paste0("\\caption{", cap, "}\n"), "\\end{figure}\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
n_areas <- nrow(ctx$areas)
```

# Identification

```{r ident, results="asis"}
env <- ctx$environment
kv <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Project", "Run", "Generated at", "Tool version", "Git",
           "R", "Platform", "renv active", "renv.lock md5", "Config file"),
  Value = c(ctx$project, ctx$run_id, ctx$generated_at, ctx$tool_version,
            if (ctx$git$available) paste0(ctx$git$commit, " (", ctx$git$branch,
                                          if (isTRUE(ctx$git$dirty)) ", uncommitted changes" else "", ")") else "not available",
            env$r_version, env$platform,
            if (env$renv_active) "yes" else "no",
            if (is.na(env$renv_lock_md5)) "no renv.lock" else env$renv_lock_md5,
            ctx$config_path),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tbl(kv)
```

Effective configuration:

```{r cfg}
cfg <- ctx$config_effective
cfg$gbif$filters_normalized <- NULL
cfg$paths <- NULL
cat(yaml::as.yaml(cfg, handlers = list(logical = yaml::verbatim_logical)))
```

# Study areas

Number of areas: **`r n_areas`** (input mode: `r ctx$input_mode`).

```{r areas, results="asis"}
tbl(ctx$areas)
fig(ctx$figures$areas_map)
```

# GBIF query

```{r filters, results="asis"}
cat("**Filters used**\n\n")
tbl(ctx$filters_table)
cat("**Data source and counts**\n\n")
r <- ctx$retrieval
tbl(data.frame(area = r$area_id, source = toupper(r$source), queried_at = r$queried_at,
               total_no_filters = r$n_total_without_filters, retrieved = r$n_retrieved,
               processed = ctx$metrics$area$n_processed))
cat("**Cache identifiers**\n\n")
tbl(data.frame(area = r$area_id, cache_key = r$cache_key))
cat("**Records removed during processing**\n\n")
tbl(ctx$removed)
cat("**Warnings and errors**\n\n")
w <- unique(ctx$warnings)
if (length(w)) cat(paste0("- ", gsub("([_#$%&{}])", "\\\\\\1", w)), sep = "\n") else cat("_None._\n")
```

# Characterisation

```{r charac, results="asis"}
m <- ctx$metrics
cat("## Records\n\n"); tbl(m$area[, c("area_id", "area_km2", "n_processed", "records_per_km2")])
cat("## Taxonomic richness\n\n"); tbl(m$taxonomic$summary)
cat("\n\n## Main groups (class)\n\n"); tbl(m$taxonomic$top_classes)
fig(ctx$figures$taxon_groups)
cat("\n\n## Spatial distribution\n\n"); tbl(m$spatial)
for (id in names(ctx$figures$records_maps)) { fig(ctx$figures$records_maps[[id]]); fig(ctx$figures$density_maps[[id]]) }
cat("\n\n## Temporal distribution\n\n"); tbl(m$temporal$summary)
fig(ctx$figures$temporal)
fig(ctx$figures$records_by_area); fig(ctx$figures$species_by_area)
```

```{r comparison, results="asis", eval=!is.null(ctx$comparison)}
cat("\n\n# Comparison between areas\n\n")
ct <- ctx$comparison$table
tbl(ct[, 1:6]); cat("\n\n"); tbl(ct[, c(1, 7:ncol(ct))])
cat("\n\nShared species (descriptive, no statistical testing):\n\n")
tbl(ctx$comparison$shared_species)
fig(ctx$figures$comparison)
```

# Limitations

```{r limits, results="asis"}
cat(paste0("- ", gsub("([_#$%&{}])", "\\\\\\1", ctx$limitations)), sep = "\n")
```
